The Priority Processor manages priority attributes on telemetry data for downstream processing.

## Overview

This processor is designed for scenarios where you need to:
- Add priority attributes to spans based on processing rules
- Mark traces with priority levels for downstream filtering or routing
- Implement priority-based telemetry processing

## Configuration

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| (Currently no configuration fields) | - | - | Configuration fields will be added as requirements are defined |

### Example Configuration

```yaml
processors:
  priority:
    # Configuration options will be added
```

## Usage

### Basic Pipeline

```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:

processors:
  priority:
    # Configuration options

exporters:
  otlp:
    endpoint: "localhost:4317"

service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [priority]
      exporters: [otlp]
```

## Behavior

This processor is currently in development. The specific priority processing logic will be implemented based on requirements.
